title: Companies
subtitle: Your companies and their departments.
deleteText: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This action cannot be undone.
accessRestrictedDesc: Your account does not have the necessary clearance to view the company directory.
companyInformationDesc: Add the company, its contact details and locations. You can add departments after saving.
companyDescPlaceholder: What the company does, in a sentence or two
geolocationPlaceholder: Google Maps link or landmark notes
uploadFailedDesc: We couldn't upload the logo. Please try again.
previewPageDesc: Company profile, contact details and departments
companyNotFoundDesc: This company doesn't exist or you no longer have access to it.
eliminateDeptDesc: Users assigned to it keep their accounts but lose this department assignment.
companyCommSettingsDesc: Configure sender aliases, default mailbox routing, and domain identity in one panel.
pickCompanyProfile: Pick the company profile whose mail infrastructure you want to manage.
domainDesc: Set the official domain used to verify outbound communication origin.
authorizedSendersDesc: Add sender aliases and click any row to mark it as the default address.
invalidFormatDesc: Please enter a valid credential email
defaultSenderUsed: Default sender used by system messages
clickToMarkDefault: Click to mark as default sender
deliveryPolicyDesc: Addresses registered here will be available as "From" aliases in the automated messaging system. The "Default Protocol" address is used for all system-triggered transactional correspondence and recovery protocols.
restrictedProtocolDesc: Your account does not have authorization to manage communication infrastructure.
gmailSubtitle: Send emails to applicants from your own Gmail account for free, and receive their replies here.
gmailStep1Desc: Google only allows App Passwords on accounts with 2-Step Verification.
gmailStep2Desc: Name it anything (e.g. "Hiring system"). Google shows a 16-letter password once — copy it.
gmailStep3Desc: Enter your Gmail address and the 16-letter App Password — not your normal Gmail password.
gmailAppPasswordPlaceholder: App Password (e.g. abcd efgh ijkl mnop)
gmailReceiveCheckbox: Also bring applicant replies into the system
gmailSecurityNote: Your App Password is encrypted and never shown again. You can revoke it anytime from your Google account, which disconnects it here too.
gmailConnectedDesc: Emails will now be sent from {email}.
gmailConnectedSendOnly: Sending works, but replies can't be received yet:
gmailReceiveDesc: Replies from applicants are checked every 5 minutes and shown on their profile. Other emails in your inbox are ignored.
gmailReceiveNotInPlan: Receiving replies isn't included in your current plan.
gmailSyncDoneDesc: {stored} new applicant replies imported ({scanned} new emails checked).
gmailDisconnectConfirmDesc: Emails will stop being sent from this Gmail account and replies will no longer be imported. Past emails stay in the system.
replySubdomainDesc: Applicant replies to emails sent from your custom domain come back here. In your DNS, add one MX record for this subdomain pointing to Resend Inbound, and subscribe your Resend webhook to the email.received event.
replySubdomainWarning: Use a subdomain only (e.g. reply.yourcompany.com). Never add Resend's MX record to your main domain — that would send all of your company's email here instead of your normal mailbox.
gmailGoogleDesc: The quickest way: approve access on Google's page and you're connected. No App Password needed.
gmailOrAppPassword: Or connect with an App Password
gmailGoogleConnectedDesc: Your Gmail is connected. Emails to applicants will now be sent from it.
resendActiveTitle: Sending from your custom domain through Resend
resendActiveDesc: Emails to applicants go out from your company's own address, and their replies come back into the system automatically. Nothing to set up here.
resendSwitchConfirmDesc: Once you connect a Gmail account, emails will be sent from that Gmail address instead of your company domain, and replies will be collected from that Gmail inbox instead of through Resend. Your Resend setup is kept: disconnecting Gmail later switches back to it.
resendSwitchNote: Connecting Gmail will replace Resend for sending and receiving. Your Resend setup is kept and comes back if you disconnect Gmail.
gmailResendKept: Your Resend (custom domain) setup is kept; disconnecting Gmail switches back to it.
gmailDisconnectBackToResend: Sending and receiving will switch back to your custom domain through Resend.
logoHint: Square images look best. The new logo is saved when you save changes.
uploadFailedText: We couldn't upload the logo. Please try again.
deptModalSubtitle: Departments group jobs and let you limit which users see which applicants.
noDepartmentsText: Add departments to organize jobs and control access.
waSubtitle: Sent from the SG Hiring WhatsApp number. Your company name appears in each message.
waNotSetUp: WhatsApp is not set up on the server yet. You can choose your settings now; nothing is sent until it is.
waConnectionError: The WhatsApp connection is not working right now
waModesHint: Automatic sends the update when it happens. Manual sends it only when someone presses send in the applicant's message window.
waEventHint_interviewScheduled: Gives the interview date and time.
waEventHint_offerSent: Tells the applicant an offer is waiting in their email.
waEventHint_interviewMissed: Tells the applicant they missed their interview and invites them to arrange a new time.
avSubtitle: Applicants confirm their email or WhatsApp number with a code before they can apply.
avEmailHint: A code is sent to the applicant's email.
avWhatsappHint: A code is sent to the applicant's WhatsApp number.
avWhatsappUnavailable: WhatsApp is not set up on this server yet
avOnlyOneNote: When both are on, applicants choose how to verify.
tgSubtitle: Post your open jobs to your Telegram channels or groups automatically.
tgNotSetUp: Telegram posting is not set up on the platform yet.
tgRemoveText: Jobs will no longer be posted there. Posts already made stay in the channel.
tgAutoHint: With auto-post on, each job is posted once when it opens for applications (jobs opened before you connected are not posted). You can post any job by hand from Jobs → Promote.
tgStep1Title: Make {bot} an admin of your channel
tgStep1a: In Telegram, open your channel and tap its name at the top.
tgStep1b: Tap Administrators (on a phone: Edit, then Administrators), then Add Admin.
tgStep1c: Search for {bot}, pick it, and keep "Post Messages" turned on. "Delete Messages" lets it remove the confirmation code for you.
tgStep1Group: Using a group instead? Do the same from the group's info: Administrators → Add Admin.
tgStep1Done: Done, the bot is an admin
tgStep2Hint: Type its public name (like @sg_jobs) or paste its t.me link.
tgStep3Title: Post the confirmation code in the channel
tgStep3Hint: Send this code as a normal message in {name}. It proves the channel is yours. The bot connects the channel as soon as it sees the code, then deletes the message.
tgWaiting: Waiting for the code… this page checks every few seconds.
tgCodeExpires: The code works until {time}. After that, start again.
tgNotSeenText: The bot hasn't seen {code} in {name} yet. Make sure you posted it in that channel, and that the bot is still an admin there.
tgConnectedText: {name} is connected. Jobs that open from now on are posted there automatically.
fbSubtitle: Post your open jobs to your Facebook Page and its Instagram account automatically.
fbNotSetUp: Facebook posting is not set up on the platform yet.
fbStep1: Press "Connect Facebook" and log in with a Facebook account that manages your company Page.
fbStep2: When Facebook asks, choose your Page, and its Instagram account if you want jobs posted there too.
fbStep3: Allow the requested access. You come back here and choose where jobs are posted automatically.
fbInstagramNote: Instagram needs a Business or Creator account linked to your Facebook Page (Instagram app → Settings → Account type, then link it from the Page settings).
fbDisconnectText: Jobs will no longer be posted to your Pages or Instagram. Posts already made stay.
fbNoInstagram: No Instagram account linked to this Page
fbAutoHint: With auto-post on, each job is posted once when it opens for applications (jobs already open are not posted). Instagram posts use the job image, which is made when someone opens Jobs → Promote. You can post any job by hand from there.
fbCallbackMissing: Facebook did not finish the login. Try again.
fbConnectedText: Pages connected: {count}. Choose where jobs are posted automatically.
integrationsDesc: Connect WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook & Instagram and applicant verification for the selected company.
